001package dev.nandi0813.api.Enum;

003/**
004 * The hotbar layouts the core rebuilds; addon items are re-applied on every rebuild.
005 */
006public enum HotbarLayout {
007
008    /** The lobby hotbar. */
009    LOBBY,
010    /** The hotbar of a player in a party. */
011    PARTY,
012    /** The hotbar of a player in a match queue. */
013    MATCH_QUEUE,
014    /** The hotbar of a player in an event queue. */
015    EVENT_QUEUE,
016    /** The staff mode hotbar. */
017    STAFF_MODE,
018    /** The hotbar of a spectator in the lobby. */
019    SPECTATOR_LOBBY,
020    /** The hotbar of a match spectator. */
021    SPECTATE_MATCH,
022    /** The hotbar of an event spectator. */
023    SPECTATE_EVENT,
024    /** The hotbar of an FFA spectator. */
025    SPECTATE_FFA
026
027}
